courses.subject: ICMS
courses.title: CMOS Radio Frequency Integrated Circuits Design
courses.description:
This subject aims to train students with the advanced knowledge of radio frequency (RF) integrated circuit design in the advanced CMOS technology, including design and analysis of widely-used RF transceiver architectures and circuits. The student will get hands-on experience to design and analyze RF integrated circuits and get familiar with the complete design flow from circuit design, layout design and parasitic parameters extraction.

The content of this course is composed of seven parts: 1)RF passive circuits and matching networks; 2) Noise and nonlinearity in RF system; 3) Communication system and standard; 4) RF transceiver architecture; 5) RF transceiver calibration; 6) RF module circuit design; 7) Introduction to mmWave IC. The students to be enrolled in this course are required to be with basic knowledge in physics, semiconductor device and integrated circuits.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Microelectronics and Integrated Circuits
courses.learning_outcomes:
Upon successful completion of this course, students will be able to:

1. Understand RFIC system and architecture design.
2. Understand popular communication system and standard.
3. Analyze important RF module circuits in advanced CMOS process.

Use mainstream EDA tools in the industry to design and optimize the performance of RF module circuits.
courses.course_syllabus:
RF passive circuits and matching networks

Noise and nonlinearity in RF system

Communication system and standard

Transceiver architecture

Transceiver calibration

Frequency synthesizer - I

Frequency synthesizer - II

Voltage-controlled oscillator and divider

Low noise amplifier

Mixer

Power amplifier

Introduction to mmWave IC
courses.feedback_evaluation:
Students are encouraged to give comments and make suggestions using the following channels:

1. There are two course evaluations - one before the mid-term, and one at the end of the course. This is a formal channel for students to rate the teacher, the course, and the course tutors. Students can give specific comments or suggestions in addition to the numeric ratings.

2. Students can provide feedback using informal channels, such as email, or simply by discussing with the tutors or the instructor directly.

courses.recommended_readings:
Willy M. Sansen, Analog design essentials. Springer, 2006.

Behzad Razavi, Design of analog CMOS integrated circuits (Second Edition). McGraw-Hill Education, 2017.

Behzad Razavi, RF Microelectronics (Second Edition). Pearson Education, Inc., 2012

courses.subject: ICMS
courses.title: Mixed-signal Integrated Circuit Design
courses.description:
This subject aims to train students with the advanced knowledge of mixed-signal integrated circuit design in the advanced CMOS technology, including design and analysis of the circuit and theory of switch capacitor circuit, analog-to-digital converter (ADC) and digital-to-analog converter (DAC). The student will get hands-on experience to design and analyze advanced mixed-signal integrated circuits and complete design flow from circuit design, layout design and parasitic parameters extraction.

The content of this course is composed of eight parts: 1) ADC/DAC fundamentals; 2) switch capacitor circuit; 3) SAR ADC; 4) pipelined ADC; 5) interleaved ADC; 6) sigma-delta ADC; 7) high resolution DAC; 8) high-speed DAC. The students to be enrolled in this course are required to be with basic knowledge in physics, semiconductor device and integrated circuits.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Microelectronics and Integrated Circuits;Not for students who have taken ELEG5769
courses.learning_outcomes:
Upon successful completion of this course, students will be able to:

1. Understand the advanced knowledge of mixed-signal IC design in CMOS process.

2. Understand the switch capacitor circuit design.

3. Analyze important ADC design including SAR ADC, pipelined ADC, interleaved ADC and sigma-delta ADC.

4. Analyze important DAC design including current steering DAC, R-2R DAC and sigma-delta DAC.

5. Use mainstream EDA tools in the industry to optimize the performance mixed-signal integrated circuits.
courses.course_syllabus:
ADC/DAC fundamentals

Switch capacitor circuit

SAR ADC

Pipelined ADC

Pipelined-SAR ADC

Interleaved ADC

Switch capacitor sigma-delta ADC

Continuous-time sigma-delta ADC

Advanced ADC architectures - I

Advanced ADC architectures - II

High-resolution DAC

High-speed DAC

courses.subject: ICMS
courses.title: Digital Automotive IC Design
courses.description:
The emerging intelligence of automotive vehicles, robots, unmanned aerial vehicles and industry equipment requires increasingly powerful computing capability embedded in vehicles, which motivates the eager demand for automotive Integrated Circuit (IC). Automotive IC is required to implement the functions needed by the electronic systems in vehicles and equipment, and to be with such characteristics as high reliability and robustness. This course intends to provide for the enrolled students with the knowledge of automotive IC, including the characteristics, design, related software and application. Further more, such advanced knowledges as AXI bus, SoC (System on Chip), high level of IC design and verification language SystemVerilog, UVM (Universal Verification Methodology) will also be provided, which is required for complicated IC in other domains besides vehicles. The students can therefore be with knowledge and design capability for both automotive IC and universal complicated IC.

The content of this course is composed of the following parts: 1) Electrical and electronic architecture of vehicle; 2) Particulars of automotive IC; 3) CAN (Controller Area Network); 4) Design methodology of digital automotive IC; 5) AXI bus; 6) Hardware and software of SoC (System on Chip); 7) SystemVerilog; 8) UVM. The students to be enrolled in this course are required to be with basic knowledge of digital IC design.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Microelectronics and Integrated Circuits;Not for students who have taken ELEG5765
courses.learning_outcomes:
1. Understand the essential knowledge and particulars of automotive IC.

2. Understand the electrical and electronic architecture of vehicle.

3. Understand the fundamental design techniques for digital automotive IC.

4. Understand CAN (Controller Area Network).

5. Understand AXI bus.

6. Understand the hardware and software of SoC (System on Chip).

7. Understand SystemVerilog.

8. Understand UVM.

9. Obtain practical experience of designing automotive IC.
courses.course_syllabus:
Electrical and electronic architecture of vehicle

Types and particulars of automotive IC

CAN

Design of digital automotive IC

AXI bus

SoC

SystemVerilog

UVM

Advanced topics
